output.answer_markdown: PepsiCo raised its FY2023 guidance after a strong first quarter. CEO Ramon Laguarta said that "given our strong start to the year," with categories and geographies remaining resilient, the company now expects full-year organic revenue growth of 8% (previously 6%) and core constant currency EPS growth of 9% (previously 8%) [3]. Q1 organic revenue growth was 14.3% and core constant currency EPS rose 18% [3]. The updated guidance implies 2023 core EPS of $7.27 (previously $7.20) [1].

provenance.quote:
Given our strong start to the year, we
now expect our full-year 2023 organic revenue to increase 8 percent (previously 6 percent)

claims.text: PepsiCo raised its full-year 2023 guidance because of a strong start to the year, with categories and geographies remaining resilient in the first quarter.
PepsiCo's Q1 2023 organic revenue growth was 14.3%.
Q1 2023 core constant currency EPS change was 18%.

provenance.quote: This assumption and the guidance above imply 2023 core EPS of $7.27 (previously $7.20)

claims.text: The updated guidance implies 2023 core EPS of $7.27, previously $7.20.
